page: Amazon Web Services m8idn.24xlarge is an eighth-generation general-purpose instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor and Intel x86_64 architecture. The system configuration delivers 96 dedicated vCPUs distributed across 48 physical cores with 2 threads per core, operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. System memory totals 384.0 GB, providing a balanced general-purpose allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The instance is equipped with integrated local high-speed storage and network capabilities. It incorporates 5,700 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD instance storage designed for low-latency access and heavy disk operations. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 150 Gbps, supporting significant I/O throughput for data synchronization and inter-node communication.

Without dedicated GPU accelerators, the instance directs its resources to CPU-bound, storage-heavy, and network-intensive tasks. The combination of dense local NVMe storage, high network bandwidth, and dedicated 3.9 GHz Intel cores offers an efficient hardware profile for large transactional databases, distributed in-memory and disk caching, big data ingestion pipelines, and high-throughput application clusters.
description: Amazon Web Services m8idn.24xlarge is an eighth-generation general-purpose instance featuring 96 dedicated vCPUs across 48 physical Intel x86_64 cores operating at 3.9 GHz. Hosted on the Nitro hypervisor, it provides 384.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance bundles 5,700 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage and delivers a 150 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Without integrated GPU hardware, its compute and I/O pipeline is built entirely for high-capacity multi-threaded execution and disk throughput. This architecture makes the m8idn.24xlarge suitable for demanding enterprise workloads including relational databases, localized analytics processing, distributed caching layers, and high-volume containerized microservices requiring substantial scratch storage and rapid data transfer.
